usage: The word 陸龜 is used specifically to refer to tortoises, not turtles that live mainly in water.
陸龜 can be used as the subject or object in a sentence, like any common noun.
It often appears in sentences about pets, animals, or nature.
When talking about slow movements, 陸龜 can be used metaphorically.
In Cantonese, 陸龜 is the standard term when distinguishing from 海龜 (sea turtle).
